line.t: The car is sold. This is eight million. All I have.
I gambled your wedding away, Tobi. I'm sorry.
Thank you for finally telling the truth, Uncle.
Keep your millions. Our children need a home, not a show.
A small wedding, then. With truth, and with love.
In-law, your jollof is better than mine.
Today, I serve. It's the least I can do.
We built this on the truth.
